verdict.rationale: Daytona documents capturing and persisting a sandbox's current state. VM sandboxes take hot snapshots that include both filesystem and memory, but container sandboxes take cold, filesystem-only snapshots, so memory preservation depends on using the VM sandbox type. The evidence frames this as snapshot capture rather than an explicit pause/resume lifecycle. Missing for 10: explicit pause/resume API documentation, memory-state retention for default container sandboxes, details on resuming a running process from a hot snapshot, independent or hands-on corroboration.
